nodes.label: Reaction Stays Per-Ingredient Rule
nodes.rationale: Never write reaction across a meal's rows with one shared value — a shared write erases a recorded allergy signal. This is the load-bearing safety rule.

nodes.label: Reaction Stays Per-Ingredient Core Rule
nodes.rationale: A meal must never write reaction across siblings with a single shared value — doing so would either fabricate reactions on ingredients that never had one, or erase a recorded allergy signal, the worst possible bug in an allergen-safety tracker.

nodes.label: scrubEvent PII Scrub Function
nodes.rationale: Pathname rewrite: every dynamic route segment replaced with [id]; query strings dropped entirely; request.data dropped; user context never set.

nodes.label: Log Form Action Transaction Wrap
nodes.rationale: Failure mid-sequence can leave inconsistent state — a custom food could persist without a successful entry insert referencing it. Wrapping in db.transaction makes it atomic.

nodes.label: recentForReminders Cap Scope Drop
nodes.rationale: The reminder rules first-introduction/repeat-exposure/stale-diversity require the full per-child history; capping silently breaks them. At realistic sizes the unbounded scan is sub-millisecond, so target dropped.

nodes.label: Report Query Dedup (allergenJoinRows removal)
nodes.rationale: allergenJoinRows is a strict subset of rows; the aggregation can be derived from rows in memory. Pure refactor, no observable change.

nodes.label: Translated Slice Scope Lock
nodes.rationale: The goal is to prove the i18n pattern is alive and used, not to translate everything; expert pediatric content and French-law-specific legal pages stay FR-only.

nodes.rationale: PRODUCT.md lists 'AI-generated meal plans' under Anti-user and 'we curate, we don't opine' as principle 8; a generated daily menu brushes against all three. The owner asked for this feature directly, so a carve-out amendment blesses a deterministic, source-cited, LLM-free meal-idea surface as an extension of /suggestions, distinct from the rejected concept.

nodes.label: Introduced-Safe Compacted-List Rotation
nodes.community_name: Quantités & Menu du jour Implementation Plan
nodes.rationale: Round-1's 'fixed universe, skip-don't-remove' was wrong: a positional walk that skips filtered entries repeats whenever the start index lands on a skipped slot. Corrected model indexes the compacted introduced-safe list via FNV-1a hash + dayIndex with a double-mod guard, giving no consecutive-day repeat while base.length >= 2.

nodes.label: Menu Engine Safety Guards
nodes.community_name: Quantités & Menu du jour Implementation Plan
nodes.rationale: The engine actively recommends meals, so suggestedAgeMonths alone is insufficient. Guards: forbidden-food/unsafe-prep filter, curated texture/choking map (seed names don't equal CHOKING_HAZARDS keys), per-allergen reaction avoidance, one-featured-novelty-per-day enforced structurally, dietary-exclusion-aware allergenFocus, nut-oil excluded from fat slot, amounts framed as repères not targets, and age-gating branch order (< 4 mo before stage lookup).
